narrative:
FY2026 budget operating income is €307.7M, +4.0% on FY2025 actuals of €295.8M. The 9+3 forecast stands at €290.1M — €17.6M below budget — even though AUM is a record €18.2bn and commissions are €1.5M ahead year-to-date.

The gap is margin, not volume. Financing costs on covered bonds and senior debt rose faster than lending margins, and group interest-rate hedges delay the benefit of higher market rates into 2027. Retail Banking (−€7.0M), Corporate Banking (−€4.1M) and Life Insurance (−€3.9M, run-off book) carry the miss; Asset Management and Private Banking are close to plan.

Key upside: if 12-month Euribor holds 25 bp higher as the hedges roll, 2027 NII gains about €6M.
